findings.actual_failure: Deleting or retargeting the row leaves every suite green.
findings.observation: No standing test checks that root AGENT_RULES.md has a row whose read cell is `docs/VERIFICATION.md`; _adopter_row_problems checks shape only.

findings.actual_failure: An agent finding the surface covered in AGENTS.md must break the one-hop rule or write a row this repository's own check rejects.
findings.observation: The lookup order lists AGENTS.md as an entry home, but the section says the verify file never mentions AGENT_RULES.md and seeded AGENTS.md always does.

findings.actual_failure: Agents choose between failed, blocked, or no grade for drift runs; the dogfood ledger breaks the shipped rule.
findings.observation: The Drift sub-section never says what grade a run classified at run start reports; ledger run r1 reports no grade, contradicting 'each run reports exactly one of five grades'.

findings.actual_failure: An agent in supervisor mode may submit an inadmissible receipt or believe it satisfies a criterion.
findings.observation: The section implies a supervised receipt counts toward acceptance and never says where a receipt is recorded, though no shipped policy admits the verify-entry producer class.

findings.actual_failure: The receipt fingerprint names a tree the run did not drive; AC-0026's each-command-output requirement is unmet.
findings.observation: Ledger run r2 paraphrases Drive 1/3 output, records no cleanup command, and claims commit b693f1ed though that commit's entry still has --target codex.

findings.actual_failure: The reference answer teaches a weaker proof bar.
findings.observation: Eval verify-entry-missing-is-task-zero says the entry is proven by launch and ready check, weaker than the doctrine's full run.
docs/VERIFICATION.md defines `<ab>` but never uses it.

findings.actual_failure: A missing target crashes the check instead of being reported.
findings.observation: _adopter_row_problems reads a missing target after flagging it and raises FileNotFoundError.

findings.actual_failure: A row routing outside the repository or through a link passes the only CI check on this repository's router.
findings.observation: The relaxed root AGENT_RULES.md row check accepts an absolute, dot-segment, or symlinked read path and reads it unbounded, instead of the blessed confined read.
